name: Ambient Focus
description: Slow evolving pads with no beat; stays out of the way for deep work.
caption: ambient, instrumental, sustained synth pads, low drone on the tonic, Lydian mode and major seventh chords, slow harmonic rhythm with one chord per 8 bars, no percussion, no fixed pulse, minimal stepwise melody, soft dynamics pp to mp, long reverb tail
notes: No tempo grid, so bar-snapped loops are not possible; rely on the crossfade loop.
description_zh: 緩慢變化的氛圍音樂，不搶注意力。
